fields.title: Output size type
fields.description: Defines how the size of the output is specified.

fields.title: Relative size
fields.description: The amount of samples relative to the original table.

fields.title: Number of rows
fields.description: The absolute amount of samples created.

fields.title: Enable static seed
fields.description: If selected, the sampling is driven by a static seed for reproducible results.

fields.title: Static seed
fields.description: You may enter a fixed seed here in order to get reproducible results upon re-execution. If you do not specify a seed, a new random seed is taken for each execution.

fields.title: Draw seed
fields.description: Generate a random seed and set it in the Random seed input above for reproducible runs.

fields.title: Append count of occurrences
fields.description: Will append a column containing the number of times this data is present in the bootstrap samples.

fields.title: Append original RowID
fields.description: Will append a column containing the original RowID in the bootstrap samples.

fields.title: RowID separator
fields.description: The bootstrap samples have a RowID that is composed of the original RowID, the separator and an incremented number for the copies of each row.
